diagrams.title: Two kinds of help for one LLM
diagrams.caption: Two kinds of help for one LLM. ① **RAG** brings in *knowledge* it wasn't trained on (the notebook). ②③ **Tools** bring in *exactness* it can't do in its head (the maths). Scripts 05 and 06 each add one of them; script 08 joins them into one agent.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 820 390" aria-label="Architecture. A friend's question goes to the trip planner LLM, which writes the answer. Before answering, matching tips from the ChromaDB travel notebook are pasted into its prompt: that is RAG. When it needs a number, it calls a tool: lookup_place reads prices, calculate_stay_share and calculate_trip_cost do the maths in Python, and each result goes back to the LLM." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <marker id="tb-m" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".6"></path></marker>
        <marker id="tb-mh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" style="fill:#835c00"></path></marker>
      </defs>
      <g class="nd soft" id="tb-q"><rect x="10" y="20" width="230" height="74" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="t13 b" x="26" y="46" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">The friends' question</text><text class="t11 sub" x="26" y="66" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">"Can 3 of us do Manali for</text><text class="t11 sub" x="26" y="82" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">4 nights with ₹20,000 each?"</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="tb-a1" x1="240" y1="57" x2="293" y2="57" marker-end="url(#tb-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <g class="nd acc" id="tb-llm"><rect x="295" y="20" width="230" height="74" rx="10" style="fill:#e1f1eb;stroke:#0d6e5b;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="311" y="46" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">Trip planner (LLM)</text><text class="t11 sub" x="311" y="66" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">ChatOpenAI · reads tips</text><text class="t11 sub" x="311" y="82" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">decides which tool to call</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="tb-a2" x1="525" y1="57" x2="578" y2="57" marker-end="url(#tb-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <g class="nd soft" id="tb-ans"><rect x="580" y="20" width="230" height="74" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="t13 b" x="596" y="46" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">The answer</text><text class="t11 sub" x="596" y="66" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">₹20,866.67 each, over budget;</text><text class="t11 sub" x="596" y="82" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">July = rain and landslides</text></g>
      <g class="nd" id="tb-kb"><rect x="10" y="180" width="370" height="150" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="26" y="204" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">Travel notebook · ChromaDB</text><text class="t11 sub" x="26" y="222" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">scripts 02 · 03 · 05</text><text class="t12" x="26" y="248" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">tips stored as text + 384 numbers + a topic label</text><text class="mono t11" x="26" y="270" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px">retrieve(query, n=3, where={"topic": ...})</text><text class="t12" x="26" y="294" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">embeddings: all-MiniLM-L6-v2, free, runs locally</text><text class="t12" x="26" y="316" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">closest in meaning, by cosine similarity</text></g>
      <g class="nd" id="tb-tools"><rect x="440" y="180" width="370" height="150" rx="10" style="fill:#ffffff;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="mono t13 b" x="456" y="204" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:13px;font-weight:700">Tools · plain Python</text><text class="t11 sub" x="456" y="222" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">scripts 01 · 06</text><text class="mono t12" x="456" y="248" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">lookup_place(place)</text><text class="t11 sub" x="600" y="248" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">→ prices (SQLite in script 01)</text><text class="mono t12" x="456" y="274" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">calculate_stay_share(...)</text><text class="t11 sub" x="660" y="274" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">→ rooms, share</text><text class="mono t12" x="456" y="300" style="font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px">calculate_trip_cost(...)</text><text class="t11 sub" x="660" y="300" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">→ total</text><text class="t11 sub" x="456" y="320" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.68">exact, every time</text></g>
      <line class="ar" id="tb-rag" x1="200" y1="180" x2="350" y2="96" marker-end="url(#tb-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab b" x="20" y="140" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">① RAG: tips pasted into the prompt</text>
      <line class="ar" id="tb-call" x1="470" y1="96" x2="590" y2="178" marker-end="url(#tb-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none"></line>
      <text class="alab b" x="462" y="160" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">② tool call</text>
      <line class="ar" id="tb-back" x1="650" y1="180" x2="510" y2="96" marker-end="url(#tb-m)" style="stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.55;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:5 4"></line>
      <text class="alab" x="655" y="160" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:11.5px;opacity:.85">③ result back</text>
      <g class="nd soft" id="tb-rule"><rect x="10" y="346" width="800" height="36" rx="10" style="fill:#f1f0ea;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.38;stroke-width:1.3"></rect><text class="t12" x="28" y="369" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:currentColor;font-size:12px"><tspan class="b" style="font-weight:700">Code computes, the LLM explains.</tspan> The LLM never does the maths in the final version: it reads, chooses a tool, and writes the answer.</text></g>
    </svg>
